message.content:
**Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Here are some key facts: | Topic | Details | |-------|---------| | **Founded** | 1754 (originally King's College) | | **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, NYC | | **Campus** | 36 acres in the Morningside Heights neighborhood; the main campus is bounded by Broadway, Amsterdam Avenue, 116th Street, and 118th Street. | | **Academic Structure** | • Columbia College (undergraduate liberal arts)
• Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
• Fu Foundation School of Engineering and Applied Science
• School of Business (Columbia Business School)
• School of Journalism (Columbia Journalism School)
• School of Law (Columbia Law School)
• School of Medicine (Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians & Surgeons)
• School of Social Work
• School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation
• School of Public Health (Mailman School)
• School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA) | | **Student Body** | ~30,000 total (≈12,000 undergraduates, ≈18,000 graduate & professional students) | | **Faculty** | Over 2,000 faculty members, many of whom are Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and members of national academies. | | **Notable Alumni** | • Barack Obama (44th U.S. President)
• Alexander Hamilton (founding father)
• Toni Morrison (Nobel laureate)
• Ruth Bader Ginsburg (Supreme Court Justice)
• Andrew Carnegie (industrialist & philanthropist)
• Many other leaders in politics, science, arts, and business. | | **Research & Innovation** | • Home to the Columbia Genome Center, the Columbia Center for Environmental Health, and the Columbia Data Science Institute.
• Strong interdisciplinary programs in climate science, artificial intelligence, and biomedical research. | | **Athletics** | NCAA Division I, Big East Conference. Teams include the Columbia Lions (men’s and women’s basketball, soccer, etc.). | | **Mascot & Colors** | Mascot: Columbia Lion (though the university has moved away from a formal mascot). Colors: Columbia Blue and White. | | **Endowment** | Roughly $10–11 billion (as of 2024), making it one of the largest university endowments in the U.S. | | **Website** | https://www.columbia.edu | **Why It Matters** - **Academic Excellence**: Columbia consistently ranks among the top universities worldwide, especially in fields like law, business, journalism, and the sciences. - **Urban Setting**: Its Manhattan location offers unparalleled access to cultural institutions, businesses, and global networks. - **Diversity & Inclusion**: The university has a strong commitment to fostering a diverse student body and inclusive campus culture. If you need more specific information—such as admissions statistics, program details, or campus life—just let me know!
